summary: Computes the reciprocal of a positive float difference: v1 = float(this+0x80) - float(this+0x84); writes 1.0/v1 to this+0x88 when v1 > 0.0, otherwise writes 0. Per-frame helper called from SuspensionAndWheelPhysics.

operations.description: v1 = *(float*)(this+128) - *(float*)(this+132), the difference between the minuend at this+0x80 and subtrahend at this+0x84.
Branch on sign of v1: if v1 <= 0.0 take the zero-assignment path, else take the reciprocal path.
*(this+136) = 0 when v1 <= 0.0 (zero floor for non-positive difference).

this+0x88 is recalculated every frame, so an external poke does not persist.
